raw: {"analysis":"Response BFD provides a more comprehensive and operationally sound plan. It correctly identifies the database schema changes as irreversible and plans for logical rollbacks, whereas PDH ambiguously treats DB changes as an afterthought. BFD also handles the flaky network check more efficiently by substituting it with a deterministic chaos harness, avoiding costly CI re-runs, while PDH allows a full 45-minute run to potentially fail before human triage. Furthermore, BFD's canary strategy (5% traffic) is more appropriate for a critical billing system than PDH's suggestion to test on 'non-billing traffic' (which defeats the purpose of validating the billing scheduler).","verdict":"BFD"}
